entities.name: Cao Cao
entities.description: Cunning, ruthless regent of the Wei kingdom who ruled by 'protecting' the child Emperor.

entities.name: Sun Quan
entities.description: Wise ruler of the Wu kingdom who fostered talented advisors and generals.

entities.name: Liu Bei
entities.description: Noble ruler of the Shu kingdom, a distant relative of the Emperor.

entities.name: Kongming
entities.description: Taoist sage and master strategist who advised Liu Bei.

entities.name: Zhang Fei
entities.description: Oath-brother of Liu Bei and the fiercest warrior in China.

entities.name: Guan Yu
entities.description: Oath-brother of Liu Bei, worshiped as a hero of the realm.

entities.name: Dong Zhou
entities.description: Warlord who seized power and enthroned the child Xian of Han.

entities.name: Lu Bu
entities.description: Warrior who killed Dong Zhou and later surrendered at Xiapi.

entities.name: Emperor Xian
entities.description: Child emperor placed on the throne by Dong Zhou and later protected by Cao Cao.

entities.name: Wei
entities.description: Northern kingdom led by Cao Cao.

entities.name: Wu
entities.description: Southern kingdom led by Sun Quan.

entities.name: Shu
entities.description: Western kingdom ruled by Liu Bei.

entities.name: Yellow Scarves
entities.description: Peasant rebels against Emperor Ling of the Eastern Han dynasty.

entities.name: Battle of Red Cliffs
entities.description: Pivotal battle where Cao Cao was defeated by Sun Quan and Liu Bei.

events.summary: The Yellow Scarves Rebellion begins and Liu Bei, Guan Yu and Zhang Fei swear the Peach Garden Oath.
events.quote: 184: The Yellow Scarves Rebellion starts, a peasant revolt against Emperor Ling of the Eastern Han dynasty.

events.summary: Dong Zhou seizes power and enthrones the child Xian of Han; Cao Cao tries to assassinate him.
events.quote: 189: Dong Zhou seizes power and places the eight year old Xian of Han on the throne.

events.summary: Cao Cao assumes protection of Emperor Xian.
events.quote: 195: Cao Cao assumes "protection" of emperor Xian.

events.summary: At the Battle of Xiapi, Lu Bu is defeated by Cao Cao and Liu Bei and surrenders.
At the Battle of Red Cliffs Cao Cao is defeated by Sun Quan and Liu Bei.
events.quote: Cao Cao is defeated by Sun Quan and Liu Bei.

events.summary: Sun Quan takes Jingzhou and later executes Guan Yu.
events.quote: 220: Guan Yu is executed by Sun Quan.

events.summary: Liu Bei proclaims himself emperor and establishes Shu; Zhang Fei is assassinated.
events.quote: Liu Bei proclaims himself emperor and establishes the Shu kingdom.

events.summary: Wu surrenders to Wei and the Sima clan reunites the empire as the Jin Dynasty.

relations.quote: the Wei kingdom , led by the cunning, ruthless, and ingenious Cao Cao
the Wu kingdom , led by the wise Sun Quan
the Shu kingdom , ruled by the noble and virtuous Liu Bei
Liu Bei was advised by a Taoist sage and master strategist, Kongming
Liu Bei's strength was also bolstered by his two oath-brothers, Zhang Fei and Guan Yu.

220: Guan Yu is executed by Sun Quan.
